_comment: The builds of Red Hat's OpenSSL FIPS provider module, by the version string the module reports
(`openssl list -providers`, and the same string inside fips.so). `cargo xtask fips host-check`
compares the module a host and an image carry against this list. A version on an active
certificate is validated; one in validation is recorded as such and only fails the check under
--require-certified; one not listed at all is unknown and treated the same way.
Sources are linked per entry; re-verify them when a UBI pin or a RHEL release changes.

modules.name: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 - OpenSSL FIPS Provider
modules.note: Validated 2024-10-29, updated 2025-11-28. Tested on RHEL 9 on Intel Xeon Silver 4216, IBM POWER10 and IBM z16 (physical). Shipped by UBI 9.2 through 9.6.

modules.name: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 - OpenSSL FIPS Provider
modules.note: Rebuilt 2026-06-03 to fix CVE-2026-31790 (RHSA-2026:28832); the build UBI 9.8 ships. On 2026-09-24 NIST's Modules In Process list showed 'Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9 - OpenSSL FIPS Provider' at Comment Resolution (2026-09-03); the list does not say which build that entry covers, so this version is not on any certificate yet.
